lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 4 visible nodes. The spatial distribution follows a semi-regular grid pattern with approximately equidistant spacing between centroids in the mid-lateral posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix where the blobs serve as anchor points along the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the longitudinal axis. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadow (low-intensity pixels) on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) is visible in the ventral space posterior to the pectoral fin.
